name: @w6w-apps/mercury
description: Manage Mercury business banking accounts, cards, recipients, invoices and money movement.

w6w.longDescription:
Mercury is a business banking platform. This app covers the read and write surface a workflow needs across a Mercury organization's accounts: listing accounts and pulling statements, reading and annotating transactions, sending money to a saved recipient or transferring between an organization's own accounts, managing recipients and expense categories, issuing and controlling virtual debit/credit cards (freeze, unfreeze, cancel), and the accounts-receivable side — customers and invoices. Organization and user reads, plus webhook management for reacting to events instead of polling, round it out.

Mercury's own API reference documents 74 paths; the two money-movement writes this app exposes (Send Money, Create Internal Transfer) are real and can move real funds — both require an idempotency key and are flagged non-idempotent by default risk, not by vendor guarantee. Several resources are deliberately left out of a first pass — see the README's 'Deliberately not covered' section, especially Mercury's own approval-request endpoints as a safer alternative to a direct send.
